name: codeguard
description: Evidence-backed lint, CVE scanning, guided fixes and Maven/Gradle impact analysis. Results distinguish pass, fail, unverified and planned.

interface.shortDescription: Lint, CVE and guided fixes for 60+ languages, commit gates
interface.longDescription: Evidence-backed code checks and Git content gates for AI assistants, with Maven/Gradle module impact analysis. Save hooks provide feedback; unverified checks are explicit. Java planning is read-only; executing project checks runs trusted build/test commands, not a security sandbox.
defaultPrompt: Run /check on the current project and fix what fails
Initialize codeguard on this repository with /init
Analyze Java module impact, then run the project's verification plan
